title: Weave: Merging based on language structure and not lines
summary: Weave is a code merging tool that understands programming language syntax and structure, allowing it to perform intelligent merges that preserve code semantics rather than treating code as plain text lines.
problem_solved: Traditional line-based text merging fails on code, causing unnecessary conflicts and manual resolution when code logic is actually compatible.
why_valuable: It dramatically reduces merge conflicts for developers by understanding code semantics, saving hours of manual reconciliation work.
